provenance_note: The isolated gateway served the Notes app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/md_notebook, website/src/apps/md-notebook), because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that app: the same backend and the same page, ported. PORTING.md lists where the two differ; none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data: fictional: a made-up hiking club notebook, written through the app's own API (see data_notes)
data_notes: capture/demo_vault.py made an empty git folder, /tmp/kc-notes-demo/trail-club-notes, with one empty commit by a made-up author; every note in it was then written through the app's own API (attach the folder, save each note, sync).
The hiking club, its members' first names and its trails are invented.

write the note Spring hike plan.md

body.content:
Three Saturdays in April, one trail each. Carpool from the library car park at 8:00.

## Route

| Date | Trail | Distance | Lead |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apr 4 | [[Cedar Ridge loop]] | 9 km | Robin |
| Apr 11 | [[Lake Mira overlook]] | 6 km | Sam |
| Apr 18 | Fern Hollow falls | 11 km | Alex |

## To do

- [x] Book the minibus
- [x] Ask the ranger station about trail closures
- [ ] Print maps for the [[Gear checklist]]
- [ ] Post the plan on the club board

> Turn back by 14:00 if the cloud comes down over the ridge.

What every hiker brings. Spares live in the club cupboard.

- [x] Water, 2 litres
- [x] Rain jacket
- [ ] Head torch with fresh batteries
- [ ] First-aid kit (one per group)
- [ ] Paper map and compass

Used on the [[Spring hike plan]].

setup.name: write the note trails/Cedar Ridge loop.md

body.content:
A 9 km loop with one steep climb to the fire lookout. Allow four hours.

## Notes from the scout walk

- The bridge at the second creek is fixed again.
- Waterfall viewpoint is muddy after rain; keep to the boardwalk.
- Good lunch spot by the lookout, out of the wind.

Planned for the first Saturday of the [[Spring hike plan]].

setup.name: write the note trails/Lake Mira overlook.md

body.content:
Short and gentle, good for new members. 6 km out and back.

- Waterfall on the left about 2 km in.
- Benches at the overlook.

Part of the [[Spring hike plan]].

Twelve members came. We picked the three spring trails and agreed on carpooling.

- Robin leads [[Cedar Ridge loop]]
- New members start on [[Lake Mira overlook]]
- Next meetup: first Thursday of May
